description: This file implements the main activity for the ContactManager app in Android. It manages UI components such as buttons, checkboxes, and a contact list, handles user interactions, and queries the Contacts content provider to display contacts. It also provides functionality to launch a contact addition activity.

classes.name: ContactManager
classes.description: Main activity class for managing and displaying contacts, with UI controls for adding contacts and toggling visibility.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets event handlers, and populates the contact list when activity is created.

methods.name: populateContactList
methods.description: Queries contacts and updates the ListView with contact entries.

methods.name: getContacts
methods.description: Retrieves a Cursor over the contacts, filtering based on visibility settings.

methods.name: launchContactAdder
methods.description: Starts the ContactAdder activity to add new contacts.
